rv.q: The all-new touring production, which had its opening night Friday at the Nederlander Theatre in Chicago, is a very different matter.

Overall, Dirty Dancing is an enjoyable, engaging experience that delights the eyes and ears-the soundtrack, featuring a great deal of late 50s and early 60s rock, is superb-and engages the mind and heart as well.
All in all, “Dirty Dancing: the Musical” is a thoroughly entertaining night at the theater.

cn.t: This touring production earns praise for director Lonny Price's fresh approach that brings new theatrical dignity to the beloved film adaptation, with audiences likely to enjoy the faithful recreation despite its well-worn nostalgia appeal.
